//: The order a reader meets docs/. Nothing else: the site's name and description are read from package.json, because a fact typed in two files is a fact that will disagree with itself.
//coverage: Every .md under docs/ must be claimed exactly once, by a `pages` entry or by a `tree`. A page claimed by neither fails the build, so a new page cannot be published unlisted, and a page claimed twice fails too. A `tree` enumerates the rest of its directory in sorted order, which is what lets 240 generated and hand-written notes stay navigable without being typed out here.
//slugs: A directory's README.md is named `<dir>/index` and served at the directory root.
